tagline.zh: 三色配比口诀:60% 主导色铺画布、30% 辅助色撑表面、10% 强调色做焦点——源自室内设计的指导原则,不是硬性规定。
tagline.en: The three-color proportion heuristic: 60% dominant paints the canvas, 30% secondary carries surfaces, 10% accent makes the focus — an interior-design guideline, not a hard rule.

origin.zh: 法则源自室内设计,由 LogRocket UX 与 hype4.academy 两篇文章交叉印证引入 UI 领域;两篇均明示它是指导原则而非硬性规定(调研 06§9)。
origin.en: The rule originates in interior design and entered UI practice via the LogRocket UX and hype4.academy articles, which cross-confirm each other and both call it a guideline rather than a rule (research 06 §9).

effect.zh: 主导色占比。默认 60 = 法则定义值(LogRocket/hype4 双源一致,调研 06§9):大面积基调,UI 中即背景画布,通常用中性色。demo 内与另两参数归一化为 100 后驱动布局,故总和不必等于 100。
effect.en: Dominant-color share. Default 60 = the rule's defining value (consistent across LogRocket and hype4, research 06 §9): the large-area base tone, i.e. the background canvas in UI, usually a neutral. The demo normalizes all three params to 100 before driving the layout, so the sum need not be 100.

effect.zh: 辅助色占比。默认 30 = 法则定义值(调研 06§9):侧边栏、卡片、面板、搜索栏等次级表面的用色,与主导色同族但拉开一档。
effect.en: Secondary-color share. Default 30 = the rule's defining value (research 06 §9): the color of secondary surfaces — sidebars, cards, panels, search bars — a same-family step away from the dominant.

effect.zh: 强调色占比。默认 10 = 法则定义值(调研 06§9):CTA、链接、图标等最鲜艳的少数元素,是界面的『焦点/行动号召』(hype4 原文表述)。
effect.en: Accent-color share. Default 10 = the rule's defining value (research 06 §9): the most vivid minority — CTAs, links, icons — the interface's 'focus / call to action' in hype4's wording.

note.zh: 设计法则,不依赖特定 CSS 特性;demo 仅用 flex 布局与普通颜色声明,所有现代浏览器可用。
note.en: A design heuristic with no CSS feature dependency; the demo uses only flex layout and plain color declarations, available in all modern browsers.

fallback.zh: 无浏览器兼容问题。demo 用 JS 归一化(三值相加后折算百分比)驱动 flex 比例;flex-grow 本身也按比例自动分配,天然完成归一化,二者互为印证。
fallback.en: No compatibility concern. The demo normalizes the three values in JS (sum, then convert to percentages) and drives flex proportions; flex-grow itself allocates proportionally, so both paths normalize for free and corroborate each other.

use.zh: 内容型产品首屏:中性画布 60% + 卡片/侧栏 30% + 主 CTA 10%(LogRocket 例证:Material 白底/浅灰组件/亮蓝按钮)
use.en: Content-product first screens: 60% neutral canvas + 30% cards/sidebar + 10% primary CTA (LogRocket's example: Material white canvas / light-gray components / bright-blue button)

use.zh: 给新团队定『色彩预算』时当沟通语言:先分主导/辅助/强调三个角色,再填具体色值
use.en: As the shared language for a team's 'color budget': split dominant/secondary/accent roles first, then fill in concrete values

use.zh: 审计现有页面的色彩构成:截图估算三色占比,超过 10% 的强调色通常意味着焦点被稀释
use.en: Auditing an existing page's color composition: estimate the three shares from a screenshot; accent creeping past 10% usually means the focus has been diluted

avoid.zh: 让所有颜色都鲜艳——hype4 原文告诫:大面积高饱和会让画面『吵』起来
avoid.en: Making every color vivid — hype4's own warning: large high-saturation areas turn the page 'noisy'

avoid.zh: 单色阶方案:只有一档灰时按钮会『消失』(hype4 提醒)——辅助/强调至少要拉开一档可感知差异
avoid.en: Single-scale schemes: with only one gray step the button 'disappears' (hype4's caution) — secondary and accent need at least one perceptible step apart

avoid.zh: 暗色模式下过度饱和——对比过高造成视觉疲劳(hype4 原文,调研 06§13);M3 暗色 accent 提亮降饱和(#6750A4→#D0BCFF)是同一告诫的官方注脚
avoid.en: Oversaturated accents in dark mode — excessive contrast causes visual fatigue (hype4's exact wording, research 06 §13); M3 brightening/desaturating dark accents (#6750A4→#D0BCFF) is the official footnote to the same warning

avoid.zh: 把 60/30/10 当硬性指标逐像素抠——两篇来源都明示它只是指导原则
avoid.en: Treating 60/30/10 as a hard metric to pixel-chase — both sources explicitly call it a guideline

a11y.zh: 占比本身不产生可访问性,三个角色之间的**对比**才产生:辅助/强调与画布的边界对比要过 SC 1.4.11 的 3:1(非文本),强调色上的文字按 wcag-contrast 条目四项阈值复核;LogRocket 例证 Spotify(黑 60/深灰 30/活力绿 10)说明暗色下同样成立,但强调色要控饱和(调研 06§9/§13)。
a11y.en: The proportions themselves are not accessibility; the **contrast between roles** is: secondary/accent boundaries against the canvas must pass SC 1.4.11's 3:1 (non-text), and text on the accent goes through the wcag-contrast entry's four thresholds. LogRocket's Spotify example (black 60 / deep gray 30 / vibrant green 10) shows the rule holds in dark mode too — with accent saturation kept in check (research 06 §9/§13).

goal.zh: 按 60-30-10 法则为界面配色:主导色(中性)铺画布、辅助色撑次级表面、强调色只留给 CTA/链接;给出三色占比的演示与归一化读数,并提示暗色下控制饱和度。
goal.en: Color an interface by the 60-30-10 rule: a neutral dominant on the canvas, a secondary for surfaces, an accent reserved for CTAs/links; include a share demo with normalized readouts and a dark-mode saturation caution.

acceptance.zh: 三色严格按 60/30/10 的角色分工落位,强调色只出现在少数焦点元素上
acceptance.en: The three colors take exactly the 60/30/10 roles; the accent appears only on a few focus elements

acceptance.zh: 主导色为中性色;辅助色与主导色同族但拉开一档可感知差异
acceptance.en: The dominant is a neutral; the secondary is same-family but one perceptible step away

acceptance.zh: 三个占比参数在 demo 内归一化为 100 后驱动布局,总和不必等于 100
acceptance.en: The three share params are normalized to 100 in the demo before driving the layout; the sum need not be 100

acceptance.zh: 不把所有颜色都调成鲜艳;暗色模式下强调色降饱和以避免视觉疲劳
acceptance.en: Do not make every color vivid; desaturate the accent in dark mode to avoid visual fatigue

acceptance.zh: 强调色上的文字与强调色边界的对比度分别满足正文与非文本阈值
acceptance.en: Text on the accent and the accent's boundary meet the text and non-text contrast thresholds respectively
